div.div:
Orange: external participant. Navy: transformation. Green open-ended symbol: retained data. * repeats the same participant or record family; it is not a new system/store. Public username/profile
search is an alternative input to profile resolution; graph ranking and fallback details remain in sequence 26. Discovery output projects public profile fields and recommendation rank/session
metadata.
